name: Cytochrome P450 (categorical mechanics)
summary: Categorical-mechanics treatment of cytochrome P450: S-expression algebra for biomolecules, P450 address manifold (k=3 family / k=6 isoform / k=9 allele clustering across ~400,000 sequences), seven-state catalytic cycle, electron transfer through CPR at fs/pm resolution, Compound I formation, C-H activation, 57 human CYP isoforms, drug metabolism. Validated against PDB, UniProt, BRENDA, ChEMBL, KEGG, PharmGKB, NIST. Headline numbers include 122 mV computed vs 120 mV measured spin-crossover redox shift (1.7% error) and 57 aF heme capacitance with 56.7 ps RC discharge.
